metadata.description: Generic agentic software-delivery pipeline: orchestrator, delivery steps, and artifact contracts. Project-independent.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Controlled multi-stage delivery pipeline. Eleven steps (autonomous, collaborative, and human-gate) that hand defined artifacts to each other via files on disk. Includes the orchestrator and the artifact contracts.

plugins.name: sdlc-context
plugins.description: Context-registry lifecycle for the agentic SDLC: scaffold a registry, connect project repos to their registries, and keep indexes, links, and crosslinks current.
